selection_reasoning: This pair creates a natural spatial dependency: a cobblestone wall acts as a physical barrier blocking access to an enclosed area containing yellow glazed terracotta. The player must first mine through the cobblestone wall (task 1) to gain access to the hidden room where the yellow glazed terracotta can be found (task 2). This is a clear multi-hop structure — the 'find' task cannot be completed without first completing the 'mine' task, since the terracotta is visually and physically inaccessible behind the wall. Both tasks require no deep Minecraft knowledge (mining a wall and visually identifying a block), and both are easily verifiable.

edges.reason: Yellow glazed terracotta is hidden behind the cobblestone wall; mining the wall grants physical access to the enclosed room containing it

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because cobblestone_wall drops itself when mined with a pickaxe, and the player starts with no cobblestone_wall in inventory. The iron pickaxe provided can mine this block. min_count=1 ensures at least one wall block was mined.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the yellow glazed terracotta and face it. Target is the center of the terracotta cluster at spawn-relative [0, 0, 8]. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered the room (impossible without first mining the wall). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the terracotta.

scene_description: A stone brick enclosed room with yellow glazed terracotta hidden inside, blocked by a 3-high cobblestone wall barrier on the front face. The player spawns facing the wall with an iron pickaxe, must mine through the cobblestone wall to access and find the yellow glazed terracotta inside.
task_text: Mine through the cobblestone wall barrier in front of you using your iron pickaxe, then enter the room behind it to find the yellow glazed terracotta blocks inside.
design_notes: Player spawns ~5 blocks from the cobblestone wall. The wall is 9 blocks wide and 3 blocks tall (using cobblestone_wall block type). Behind it is a stone brick room (interior 7x4x3) containing 5 yellow glazed terracotta blocks. The area between player and wall is cleared. Air commands ensure no trees block the approach. Stone floor provides clean ground.
